settings_form_error_type: This value isn't the right kind. Enter a new one, or reset it.
settings_form_error_socket_addr: Enter an address and a port, like 0.0.0.0:8090 or [::]:8090.
settings_form_error_url: Enter a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
settings_form_error_host: Enter a host name or an IP address, like nas.local or 192.168.1.5.
settings_form_error_time_range: Enter a start and an end in 24-hour time, like 03:00-05:00. A window can run past midnight, like 22:00-02:00.
settings_form_error_time_range_same: The window starts and ends at the same time. Choose a different end.
settings_form_error_needs_confirmation: This change needs a confirmation this screen can't show, so nothing was saved. Make it from its own Settings screen.
settings_form_error_schema: This screen and Lodestar don't agree about a setting, so nothing was saved. Reload the page, then try again.
settings_form_error_server: Lodestar couldn't save the change. Your changes are kept; try again.
settings_form_offline: Couldn't reach Lodestar. Your changes are kept.
settings_form_note_locked: Your change was dropped: this setting can no longer be changed in the app.
settings_form_note_locked_env: Your change was dropped: {variable} now sets this setting.
settings_form_announce_saved_restart: Saved. Some changes apply after a restart.
settings_form_announce_undo_stale: Undo isn't possible any more: these settings were changed since. The current values are shown.
settings_form_announce_merged: These settings were changed elsewhere. Your changes are kept; review them and save again.
settings_form_announce_conflicts: Some settings were changed elsewhere. Choose which value to keep, then save again.
settings_form_announce_removed: Settings that no longer exist were left out of your changes: {count}.
settings_form_env_help: To change it, edit the variable in the container template or the environment, then restart Lodestar.
settings_form_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
settings_form_pending_reset: Goes back to the default when you save.
settings_form_secret_remove_body: Lodestar forgets the saved value at once. This can't be undone: to use it again, you'll need to enter it again.
settings_form_json_invalid: This isn't valid JSON yet. Check the brackets, commas and quotes.
settings_form_discard_body: Your changes on this screen are lost. The saved settings stay as they are.
settings_form_disruptive_fields: This changes {fields}, which interrupts what Lodestar is doing.
settings_form_disruptive_url: Lodestar will be at {url} after a restart.
settings_form_disruptive_generic: Crawling or search may stop until Lodestar restarts.
settings_form_leave_body: Changes on this screen aren't saved yet ({count}).
settings_form_summary_title: Nothing was saved. Fix these first:
settings_form_draft_title: You have unsaved changes from earlier
settings_form_draft_body: Restore them to keep editing, or discard them.
settings_form_draft_dropped: Restore them to keep editing, or discard them. Some no longer apply and are left out: {count}.
settings_form_busy: Lodestar is busy. Your changes are kept; try again in {seconds} seconds.
settings_form_chunk_failed: Part of this page couldn't load. Check your connection, then reload the page.
settings_form_load_error: Couldn't load these settings. Check that Lodestar is running, then retry.
settings_transport_utp_help: Fetch metadata over uTP (BEP 29) as well as TCP. Not active yet: uTP has no effect until a later release, so changing this only changes what is saved.
